newsitem.title: UK: First Technology up on H1 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: First Technology up on H1 profit rise.

text.p: Shares in auto safety and sensing specialist First Technology Plc rose on Wednesday on the back of a 28 percent rise in first-half pre-tax profits and an upbeat statement.

First Technology said pre-tax profit rose to 4.2 million stg in the first half ended on October 31, from 3.3 million stg for the same period last year. The shares were up 15-1/2p to 672-1/2p at 1423 GMT.
"We entered the second half of the year with strong order books in both operating divisions and a sound financial position," said chairman Fred Westlake.
"The group has important new business coming on stream and it also enjoys strong market positions in high growth product areas."

Westlake said the core car safety, electronics and analysis units were performing well as car manufacturers made them an increasing priority. International growth by some customers, notably Fiat, were also improving the outlook, he said.
He also saw an increase in demand for child and small adult crash dummies, due to mounting concern over the safety of children due to airbag failures.
Turnover rose 30 percent to 23.4 million stg and the dividend was up 31 percent to 4.2p.
